title: Bluecon: reading historical data older than 20 minutes ago

comments.body:
no, reading last 8h is a lot more complicated and Battery intensive.

you can have a look at how it's done using NFC.
Thanks for the quick reply. I'll play around a bit and see if I can get it working satisfactorily (maybe hidden behind a preference).

There is one simple advice to get the 8 hours data:
Follow this page: https://github.com/tzachi-dar/LibreOOPAlgorithm

It will also give you results very close to the libre reader with no need for calibration.

Thanks very much! The LibreOOPAlgorithm extension works fabulously. Interesting to see the difference in values (in my previous testing of the Libre Reader, the values seem to be slightly less accurate than a well-calibrated value in xDrip, but that's a matter for the FreeStyle team!). I'll mark this issue as closed.
